title: Copy the Source Motif to the Target Tile
skills: source-target transfer, tile selection, motif copying
written_solution: Identify the source tile by its red(2) motif and the target tile by its green(3) marker. Then copy the source shape into the target tile, recoloring the copied cells to cyan(8).
